statement_en: Across these papers, feeding live bait fish to mandarin fish is described as raising the risk of disease and parasite problems, because bait fish can carry pathogens or parasites, such as bacteria and viruses, and be injured when handled, which can lead to outbreaks and mass mortality. One measured study found a high ISKNV virus positivity rate in farmed fish and their bait fish, suggesting bait as a route of infection. Most other claims restate this as background or inference rather than measuring disease outcomes. One liver study found normal hepatocytes in the live-bait group, and one claim only notes lower drug spending.

basis.summary: All the mandarin fish evidence comes from one 2026 paper (S546) with measured results that consistently show harm, so I weighted those claims most; the gossypol mechanisms are speculative and flagged as such, the enzyme and gene results were mixed (gut up, brain down), and the other-species background claims (C1607, C16399) and the garbled C16355 were left out.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fishmeal with cottonseed protein concentrate worsened feeding-related outcomes: at 17.5% replacement and above, growth and feed utilisation fell significantly, feed intake rate dropped above 35%, and survival and per-fish feed intake dropped above 52.5%. Appetite-gene expression changed (up in the gut, down in the brain), and the fish appeared to be in an energy deficit; the gossypol explanation for the appetite drop is only speculative.
statement_zh: 在鳜上，棉籽浓缩蛋白替代鱼粉对摄食相关指标不利：替代17.5%及以上时生长和饲料利用率显著下降，替代超过35%时摄食率显著降低，超过52.5%时存活率和个体摄食量也显著降低。食欲相关基因表达出现变化（肠道升高、脑中下降），鱼体可能处于能量不足状态；至于棉酚抑制食欲的说法，目前只是推测。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, feeding frequency affected feeding-related outcomes, but the best frequency varied between studies. One study measured growth rising then falling with more feedings, best at 3–4 times a day and worst at once a day. Another, on training fish to accept dead feed, found twice a day worked better than four times, with lower acceptance, more aggression and suppressed appetite genes at four. In a study of Siniperca chuatsi on diets with different sugar levels, more feeding raised feeding rate but could lower feed use and growth, and did not help when dietary sugar was too low. Much of the rest is background from other fish species.
statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，投喂频率会影响摄食和生长，但各研究得出的适宜频率并不一致。一项研究测得，随投喂次数增加生长先升后降，每天3～4次最好、每天1次最差。另一项关于驯食的研究发现，每天2次比4次好，4次时驯化率下降、攻击行为增多、食欲相关基因表达也向抑制方向变化。在不同饲料糖水平的试验中，增加投喂次数会提高摄食率，但在某些条件下反而降低饲料利用率和生长，糖水平过低时增加次数也无法改善生长受阻。其余多为其他鱼类的背景报道。

statement_en: In mandarin fish, changing the feeding rate altered body indices, feeding rate, digestive enzyme activity, body protein and fat, and some blood markers. Effects on growth were conditional: weight gain rose with feeding level at twice-daily feeding but did not differ at once-daily feeding, and one study put the best rate for acclimation at 13.34% with low and high rates reducing feeding motivation. Reduced satiation affected growth in one study, yet 80% and 100% satiation did not differ in weight gain, and total cholesterol did not differ across satiation levels.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing live bait with artificial feed mostly lowered feeding-related performance: intake, growth rate and feed use were lower in several papers, and digestive enzymes, gut structure and appetite-related genes changed. Some measured papers instead found similar growth or survival, or better feed efficiency, especially after acclimation, and survival differed between papers (lower on pellets in some, no difference in others).

basis.summary: Four of the five claims are measured, but they describe molecular markers of weaning (gene expression, methylation) rather than welfare outcomes; C1009 is the only one on overall outcome, and it is mixed (success with large individual variation), while C13459 only describes the design, so I stated that no clear welfare effect is shown.

statement_en: The claims do not show a clear welfare effect of switching mandarin fish from live feed to formulated feed. Domestication to formulated feed was overall successful, but individuals varied markedly in how well they adapted. Other measured claims only link gene changes to adaptation (scd1 expression first fell then rose; pck1 expression was lower and its methylation higher in easily-weaned fish), and one study describes its design without giving results.

The one direct measurement found no significant effect on feed intake, and fermented soybean meal raised intake but was poorly utilised because of amino acid imbalance.

Results are not uniform: one study found no effect of protein level on fry survival, and another found lower lipase activity in the mid-protein groups.

Two other papers say 12.5% replacement was accepted and did not harm growth, but they only report this briefly.

statement_en: The three claims point in different directions on how water temperature affects feeding in mandarin fish. One measured study found no effect of water temperature on daily feed intake or protein efficiency ratio. Another, reported as background, says low temperature lowered digestive enzyme and acid-secretion activity, which recovered with warming along with a clear gain in body weight. A third says only that temperature significantly affects feeding, and it refers to yellow catfish rather than mandarin fish.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, ammonia nitrogen exposure harmed welfare in a dose-dependent way: in one study, 96-hour mortality in juveniles rose from 0% to 100% as total ammonia nitrogen went from 10.39 to 15.03 mg/L (LC50 12.91 mg/L). Over 28–30 days, lower concentrations (0.61–2.58 mg/L) raised oxidative stress markers and liver enzymes (ALT, AST), lowered serum total protein and inhibited gill Na+-K+-ATPase early on. Several indicators did not differ between groups at day 30 or changed over time, and a separate seven-day test found no extra gill damage and no deaths despite high ammonia, but reduced appetite.
statement_zh: 对翘嘴鳜来说，氨氮暴露会按浓度加重福利损害：一项研究中，幼鱼96小时死亡率随总氨氮从10.39升到15.03 mg/L由0%升至100%（半致死浓度12.91 mg/L）。在28～30天的慢性暴露中，较低浓度（0.61～2.58 mg/L）就使氧化应激指标和肝功能酶（ALT、AST）升高，血清总蛋白下降，早期鳃Na+-K+-ATPase活性受抑。但部分指标在第30天组间无差异，或随时间有变化；另一项为期7天的试验在高氨氮下未见鳃损伤加重，也没有死亡，但摄食受到抑制。

statement_en: If the water is changed in time before breathing stops, most ribbon fish can recover; if the water is not changed, the fish will quickly stop breathing and die from shock.

statement_en: The two claims do not show pH measurement changing mandarin fish welfare: one only describes using a pH meter to measure pH, and the other infers that pH did not change significantly among ammonia nitrogen groups, so its effect on enzyme activity could be ignored.

basis.summary: Weight rests on measured claims from several papers (S027, S540, S523, S086) giving water-quality values or a comparison; claimed and background statements only support this, many others merely describe the system, and no claims disagree.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, recirculating aquaculture systems were reported to keep water quality stable and within suitable ranges. Measured values included dissolved oxygen above 6 mg/L (in one study averaging 9.13 mg/L), pH about 7–8, and low ammonia and nitrite (averages of 0.13 and 0.03 mg/L in one study). One comparison reported higher dissolved oxygen and improved ammonia, nitrite, phosphorus and COD. No claim reported a negative effect, and many others only describe the system or give background.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼养殖中，多项研究称循环水养殖系统能使水质保持稳定、处于适宜范围。实测数据包括溶解氧高于6 mg/L（一项研究平均9.13 mg/L）、pH约7–8，氨氮和亚硝酸盐较低（一项研究平均分别为0.13和0.03 mg/L）；一项对比研究称其溶氧更高，氨氮、亚硝酸盐、磷和化学需氧量也有改善。没有结论显示负面影响，其余不少内容只是对系统的描述或背景介绍。

basis.summary: The statement rests mainly on measured water-quality claims from paper S068 (C1757, C1762, C1763, C1776), which agree with each other; the lower microbial diversity (C1758, C1792) is reported as a mixed or counter point, and the second paper (C8991) is only a claim without measurement, so it carries little weight.

statement_en: In mandarin fish ponds, the pond rice floating bed was measured to give lower ammonium, nitrite, nitrate, total nitrogen, total phosphorus and alkalinity in the water than the control, with ammonium staying nearly unchanged in the floating bed ponds. Microbial diversity in the water went down with the floating bed, which one claim reads as a drawback, and a second paper only states that rice planting purifies pond water.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼池塘里，水稻浮床组水体中的氨氮、亚硝酸盐氮、硝酸盐氮、总氮、总磷和碱度都比对照组低，浮床组氨氮变化很小。不过浮床组水体微生物多样性有所下降，有一条结论把这看作不利的一面；另一篇文献只是说池塘种稻有净化水质的作用。

statement_en: When using rice straw-based biofloc to farm Litopenaeus vannamei, total ammonia nitrogen and nitrite nitrogen levels were maintained below 1 mg/L throughout the entire 30-day culture period.
